prompt:
You match supplier price-list items to a product catalog.
Decide which catalog candidate, if any, is exactly the same product as the price-list item.
How to decide:
1. Find the model number (letters and digits, e.g. PSLX350H or MDR-J10) in the price-list item.
2. A candidate with the same model number is the same product, ignoring case, dashes and spaces,
   and ignoring a colour or variant suffix such as /BLUE or BK/WH on an otherwise identical base
   model. Different wording, descriptions or prices do not matter.
3. If no candidate shares the model number, pick one only when brand and product type are the
   same and the names share distinctive words. Otherwise answer "none".
4. Never answer "none" only because the wording or the price differs.
Confidence: 0.9 or more when the model number matches; 0.6 to 0.8 when brand and product type
match but no model number can be compared; below 0.5 when you are unsure.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else. Write "reason" first: one sentence that
compares the model numbers of the item and the best candidate. Then decide.
{"reason": "<comparison>", "choice": <number 1..N or "none">, "confidence": <0.0..1.0>}

Price-list item:
name: Canon Silver PowerShot Digital Camera - SD880IS; brand: canon; description: Canon Silver PowerShot Digital Camera - SD880IS/ 10 Megapixel/ 4x Optical Zoom/ Optical Image Stabilizer/ 3.0' PureColor LCD II/ DIGIC 4 Image Processor/ Face Detection Self-Timer/ Red-Eye Correction/ 19 Shooting Modes/ Print/Share Button/ Silver Finish

Candidates:
1. name: Canon PowerShot SD1100 IS Digital ELPH Camera - Swing Silver - 2508B001; brand: Canon; description: Canon PowerShot SD1100 IS 8 Megapixels, ISO 1600, 3x Optical Zoom Digital Camera - Swing Silver; check: model numbers differ, brand equal
2. name: Canon PowerShot SD990 IS 14 Megapixel Digital Camera w/ 3.7x Optical Zoom, UA Len, Face Detection, 2.5 LCD, & ISO 1600 - Silver - 3191B001; brand: Canon; price: $299.88; check: model numbers differ, brand equal
3. name: Canon PowerShot SD890 IS Digital Camera - 2566B001; brand: Canon; description: Canon PowerShot SD890 IS 10 Megapixel, 5x Optical Zoom, 2.5' LCD, UA Lens Digital Camera; price: $198.00; check: model numbers differ, brand equal

response.text: {"reason": "The price-list item has model number SD880IS, which does not match any candidate's model number exactly.", "choice": "none", "confidence": 0.5}
